task: Block navigation to routes belonging to disabled feature flags by wrapping route definitions in FeatureGuard components within the router

technical_risk.label: S

technical_risk.mitigation: FeatureGuard pattern is already established and used in the same file for analytics, budgets, users, MCPs, teams bot, and favorites routes — exact copy-adapt execution

key_reasoning.reason: Route gating is authorization-adjacent; slight bump from XS to S because incorrect feature-flag mapping could silently block or expose routes. Mitigated by the exact FeatureGuard pattern already used 8+ times in the same file.
